Watch the violent right edge of the BUDE, Mississippi wedge #tornado on May 6, 2026

This was a classic long-track grinder of Dixie Alley 

#stormchasing https://t.co/IjSwzK2N20

Thank you @MikeMorganKFOR for stating the importance of never stop chasing here in Oklahoma 

I sure do miss the KFOR-TV days. https://t.co/Q4pN5lbcmW
THUNDER UP https://t.co/W04KztuD9J

Happy Saturday from Team Dominator!

We have accelerated production of the Dominator 3 models at @willclay25 Dominator laboratory.

You can get yours at https://t.co/U1wv6bY242

These Dominator 3 models are in support of our 2027 science mission. We plan to deploy all three https://t.co/sFiqDIxMo2

The Northwest doesn't get a break this week: up to 12 inches of rain in the Olympics.

Seattle could tie its record high Wednesday, then an atmospheric river parks right over Western Washington Friday into Saturday. https://t.co/Fso3Y4uxp3
The nicest weather in the USA today will be in and around Tucson, AZ, Blanding, UT, and Columbus, OH. https://t.co/WLZPAhD0be

Water was rushing right across US 281 near Alice, Texas this morning, and cars got stuck in it.

Photo: Erica Rodriguez https://t.co/WLlqYtVzQJ
Flash flood warnings are up for Kleberg, Jim Wells, Duval and Cameron counties, and a flood watch runs through Monday. If you're down there, don't drive into flooded roads.
Almost 9 inches of rain today near Kingsville, Texas, and it's still coming down. https://t.co/f6IOPHR2PT

There's been a lot of talk about a potential Northeast snowstorm this week, but for most people, this is going to be a rain event...

The real snow stays in the mountains and the interior, while New York, Philly and Boston just get a chilly rain. https://t.co/MUtpQh7qZs

HAPPY BIRTHDAY to legendary storm chaser Bryce Shelton! 🎉

@bryceshelton01 https://t.co/tNBpgTlg5v

Brownsville got more than TWICE its normal November rainfall in a single day...

Today’s 3.65" was the city’s 2nd-wettest November day since records began in 1878. 

Only eight days into the month, this November already ranks as the 4th-wettest on record. https://t.co/3eQMS5iLiy

UP TO 8 INCHES of rain has fallen in parts of South Texas since yesterday afternoon... 

Flash flooding is ongoing near Kingsville, and a Flash Flood Warning covers the Hill Country until 8 PM. https://t.co/ySWNYKOlFN
7 cities across the Southwest and Plains have had more 90° days this year than any year on record... https://t.co/epMkQeUimD

Our research efforts continue and we have a ton of projects in the works for the next few months.

The premium subscription which we are adding soon will help support our research efforts while we keep the most critical info (short range data & daily forecasts) free.

There are several other new features and enhancements as well that are now live on the website and on the mobile app (iOS and Android).

Read more here https://t.co/vF3i4IjXqW https://t.co/ANbfkkqwDf

Texas had a wet Sunday with rainfall totals of 6-8 inches across southern Texas and near 2-3 inches across the Hill Country. Locally heavy rainfall will continue today. A Slight Risk ERO was issued near Corpus Christi southwards to Brownsville to account for saturated soils. https://t.co/lTvwuncdLV
